source_en: Pavle Asatiani. Butcher, end of the market row. Don't stare at the face.
The bandages bother you? They bother me more. Ask, if you have to.
Meat grinder. You don't feel it until an hour later.
Not here. You'd lose your appetite, and you look underfed already.
My brother's old stall. Ration meat, mostly. Nobody asks what animal.
He cried for a week before he left. Now I'm [[whisper:the one wearing it]].
Whatever comes in. Keep asking like that and you'll outlast the last one.
